item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it consistently matters more than taking it perfectly. Tie it to something you already do every day, like your morning routine or brushing your teeth, so it doesn't rely on memory or mood. If you've missed doses or have side effects, don't adjust anything on your own. Bring it to your prescriber. Your action: set one daily reminder for your medication, at the same time each day, right now.
